landing.header: There are Many Ways To Electrify
landing.headerDescription: Please register or sign in, then you will be prompted to tell us more about your specific requirements so we can recommend the appropriate equipment for your needs, identify incentives, and estimate cost savings. We can help with:
landing.fleetMessage: Compare the total costs of fleets of electrifying your fleet. See a quick example of a fossil fuel to electric fleet comparison by clicking “Continue as Guest” below.
landing.workplaceMessage: Discover how much it costs to install chargers at your workplace.
landing.publicMessage: Compare the costs and revenue of providing public chargers.
landing.MUDMessage: Find out how much it costs to install chargers at multi-unit dwellings (MUD).
landing.alertMessage: Looking to replace your existing Fossil Fuel Fleet? See how much you can save by electrifying your fossil fuel fleet, available as a guest user

default.subMessage: Select your first vehicle. If you select a Fossil Fuel vehicle, an EV replacement will be selected for you. If you do not want to include vehicles in your comparison, please create a new project and select a different project type.
default.alertMessage: If operating multiple vehicles over varying distances, consider grouping them into separate sets. You can create additional sets at the end of this setup wizard by clicking Create Scenario.
